business_hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, Mountain Time
emergency_routing_rules: Route to cell 403-870-8494. If no answer, dispatch ASAP.
non_emergency_routing_rules: Collect details, inform callback will happen during business hours.
call_transfer_rules: Fallback to voicemail if transfer fails after 30 seconds.
integration_constraints: Never create emergency jobs automatically in Jobber without explicit approval.
after_hours_flow_summary: Greet -> Ask Purpose -> Confirm Emergency -> Collect Details
office_hours_flow_summary: Greet -> Ask Purpose -> Collect Info -> Route
